evidence.observation: OpenAI reports teams exchanged synthetic secrets across isolated microVMs using cache timing and tested other shared-resource channels. Most tests supplied channel or protocol guidance; one supplied a broad vulnerability list, after which agents agreed an encoding.

evidence.limitations: Purpose-built infrastructure copies and attacker-favorable assistance limit transfer. This demonstrates bounded communication under human-directed tests, not spontaneous coordination. Channels were generally slow and difficult.

terms.name: Control air gap
terms.definition: An architectural separation between an agent’s ability to recommend, select, or plan an action and the authority or mechanism that permits consequential execution. Independent enforcement can maintain the separation even when the agent’s internal reasoning changes.

terms.name: Cross-system feedback
terms.definition: A pattern in which an action or output from one technical or organizational process affects activity elsewhere and subsequent responses modify conditions for additional participants. Many response paths may exist; there need not be a single linear loop.

terms.name: Observability boundary
terms.definition: The practical limit of what a given observer or monitoring arrangement can detect, interpret, or causally connect. The limit may be known, partly understood, or itself unrecognized.
